messages:
Nia: kicking off a short "terminology handoff" playbook draft for doc PRs. goal: reduce back-and-forth on naming and snippet style.
Omar: yes please. include a tiny canonical glossary path and who owns it.
Jules: propose /docs/reference/glossary.md and a single owner field at top of file. keeps edits auditable.
Tess: for code examples: keep them runnable and idiomatic (JS -> camelCase, Python -> snake_case). show expected output for clarity.
Nia: adding a mini migration checklist: 1) glossary entry, 2) snippet update with smoke test, 3) redirect or link fix, 4) changelog bullet.
Omar: label suggestions: docs/terminology, docs/snippet, docs/migrate. CI can auto-add.
CI Bot: sample GH Action to label PRs touching docs: ```yaml
name: label-docs
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/labeler@v2
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
Jules: voice note: be concise and technical. add a do/don't pair for marketing-sounding phrases.
Tess: for ambiguous terms, recommend "model variant" for quantized/tuned builds and "model" for topology. include exact sentence examples.
Nia: volunteers to draft the playbook tonight. @Omar can you add the GH Action? @Tess take snippets, @Jules do the voice examples.
Omar: will do.
Tess: will write snippet tests (one-liners).
Jules: on it.
Docs Bot: I'll comment on PRs labeled docs/terminology with a link to the playbook once it's merged.
Nia: perfect. i'll open PR and ping reviewers. thanks :thumbsup:
